reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed the agent's V4 (final rung) per-platform ladder: pred4 = k*(pred0 - bias)_shifted(-1) - (a + b*v_mps), with (bias,k,a,b) = (+0.00075, 1.0941, -0.00232, +0.000110) for FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 and (+0.00443, 0.8665, -0.00039, +0.000023) for FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1, taken from the agent's rpi/runs/20260527-1555/ladder_*.txt logs.
notes: Agent's headline was per-platform on a 4:1 interleaved TEST split; canonical eval pools all qualifying samples (v_mps>2.0) across both Ford platforms with no train/test split. Per-platform V4 coefficients were read from the agent's own run logs (rpi/runs/20260527-1555/ladder_mustang.txt and ladder_f150.txt) and re-applied via the same pipeline order as tools/run_ladder.py (bias removal, -1 sample lag-shift with edge padding, steering-gain scaling, then speed-residual subtraction).
